body:
Good morning, Bakersfield. It's Saturday, August 22, 2026, and we're waking up to a warm morning with temperatures already in the 90s. Today's top story is the arrest of a 15-year-old suspect in connection with last night's deadly shooting at Independence High School. We'll have more on that below. Right now, expect a high near 103° and an air quality index of 64 — moderate.

## The Kern Overnight

The night brought a series of notable incidents across Kern County. Just after midnight, a shooting was reported at a Taco Bell in the Baker Street area. A witness told officers they saw someone shot, and the suspect was described as a white male in his 40s to 50s, wearing a black shirt and dark pants, sitting inside a white vehicle — possibly a Ford Explorer. Officers responded with an officer-safety broadcast. Earlier in the night, around 2:16 a.m., flames were visible inside a vacant single-story house on King Street with heavy smoke showing. Multiple engines and a truck company responded, and the fire was under control by about 2:25. Just before 11 p.m., a two-vehicle collision left one vehicle on fire near Gosford Road and Harris Road. Engine 14 and Engine 9 responded — one car was smoking with another about a quarter mile back — and command dubbed it the Harris Incident. Injuries from that incident are unknown. Multiple reports of a grass fire also drew a large response along southbound Highway 395 north of Brown Road. Crews found a small roadside fire that was quickly extinguished, and the extra equipment was canceled. In other incidents, an assault with a knife was reported around 10:38 p.m. with no injuries; the suspect fled on foot northbound. A subject with a firearm in his waistband was reported on Houchin Road around 10:04 p.m., described as a Hispanic male in his 20s in a white shirt and brown pants with boots. An assault was reported on Birch Avenue in Wasco around 11:22 p.m., with medics dispatched. A hit-and-run involving a black Camry and a white sedan occurred on Monterey Street around 11:23 p.m. Two fire hydrants were reported spilling water on 22nd Street between Q and P streets around 11:53 p.m. Around 12:01 a.m., about a half acre was burning behind a residence on Windsong Street, with crews working and additional resources requested. A suspicious vehicle check occurred on Culiacan Avenue around 12:09 a.m., involving a Honda Civic occupied by a woman in her 20s. A family disturbance on Suncrest Drive around 12:10 a.m. involved an intoxicated teenager who came home, with a family member holding him down. A welfare check was requested for a man lying on the ground near the curb on 26th Street around 12:12 a.m. And an assault in progress with multiple people inside and a disturbance heard was reported around 12:20 a.m.

## Today's weather

Today's weather will be hot and dry. Expect a high near 103° and a low around 75° tonight. It's currently 97° at Meadows Field (KBFL). There are no active weather alerts for Kern County at this time. Air quality is 64 — moderate. No active fires have been reported in the county this morning.

## Top stories

**KGET 17 reports that Bakersfield Mayor Karen Goh has released a statement on the deadly shooting at Independence High School.** The mayor expressed her condolences to the family of the victim and urged the community to cooperate with law enforcement as the investigation continues. She emphasized that the safety of students is a top priority and that the city is working closely with the school district to ensure that measures are in place to prevent such incidents in the future.

**According to 23ABC, officials have announced the arrest of a 15-year-old suspect in connection to the deadly shooting at Independence High School's football game.** The suspect was taken into custody Saturday morning in the 7500 block of Stockdale Highway. No other arrests have been announced, and no other suspects have been identified at this time. The investigation is ongoing, and police are asking anyone with information to come forward.

**Bakersfield Now tells us that Southwest Market has canceled its Saturday event at Independence High School following the fatal shooting.** Organizers said the decision was made out of respect for the victim and the community. The event was scheduled to take place on the school's campus, but given the circumstances, they felt it was inappropriate to proceed as planned. They expressed their condolences to the affected families and the community.

## Something good

In a bit of positive news, a local family is hosting a flea market today to raise funds for a community member in need. The event aims to collect $8,900 to help cover the cost of a prosthetic leg for Villafana. It's a heartwarming example of neighbors coming together to support one another during challenging times.

## Coming up this week

Looking ahead, there are several events and meetings on the calendar for this week. On Tuesday, August 26, the Bakersfield City Council will hold a Special City Council Meeting at 12:00 p.m., followed by a regular City Council Meeting at 3:30 p.m. and another at 5:15 p.m. On the entertainment front, the Fox Theater will host a variety of shows, including Los Yonic's Zamacona, Los caminantes, y Grupo Yndio tonight, August 22. On Tuesday, August 26, the theater will offer a Cults & Classics: Season Pass for the 2026-2027 season. Comedian Rodney Carrington will perform on Thursday, August 28, followed by CUMBIATRON: THE CUMBIA RAVE on Friday, August 29. Also on Friday, Willie Barcena and Michael Return Of The King Tribute Featuring Michael Phoenix will take the stage. Be sure to check the Fox Theater's website for ticket information and showtimes.
